newsitem.title: USA: CVS sees Q4 EPS "slightly" topping estimates.
newsitem.headline: CVS sees Q4 EPS "slightly" topping estimates.

text.p: CVS Corp Friday said it expects fourth-quarter and 1996 share earnings to slightly exceed analysts' average estimates of $0.40 and $1.40, respectively.

Tom Ryan, vice chairman and chief operating officer, said, "The results reflect solid gains in our front-end and pharmacy businesses; continued expansion of our store base, with the opening of 98 new locations over the course of the year; and significant cost reduction initiatives. Moreover, we are optimistic our momentum will continue in 1997 as we move ahead with our growth strategy."
CVS and Revco D.S. Inc recently confirmed they were discussing a merger between the two drugstore giants.
